name: Resume the spent original Flash Bolt pending cast in a fresh process

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original scroll inspection')
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c359))
 local th=target and target:isValid() and Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current or -1
 if target and target:isValid() and not core.isWorldPaused() then
  local aim=target:getBoundingBox().center
  local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
  local angle=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z)
  local elevation=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
  local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}})
  print(string.format('ScrollUse look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(elevation*256+.5)))))
  if math.abs(angle)<.01 and math.abs(elevation)<.01 and ray.hitObject and ray.hitObject.id==target.id then print('ScrollUse aimed original bandit') end
 end
 print('ScrollUse sample flashbolt='..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x888bf))..' chameleon='..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x84aeb))..' magicka='..Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' targetHealth='..th..' targetDead='..tostring(target and target:isValid() and Actor.isDead(target))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
end}}}}
